 Print CAT 2026 admit cards will be available for download from November 6 at iimcat.ac.in. The examination is scheduled for November 29 in three shifts. The Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 admit cards will not be released today, November 4, as initially scheduled. The hall tickets will now be available for download from November 6, 2026, according to the revised schedule mentioned in the examination information. Candidates who have registered for the management entrance examination will be able to access their admit cards through the official website, iimcat.ac.in, using their CAT application login ID and password. The admit card download window will remain open until November 29, 2026, the date of the examination. Candidates should note the revised release date and plan their examination-related preparations accordingly. The examination authorities have also outlined additional security measures for the smooth and secure conduct of CAT 2026. CAT 2026 admit card : Revised release date and download window
 As per the revised schedule, CAT 2026 admit cards will be available from November 6 to November 29, 2026. The examination authority has confirmed that admit cards for all eligible candidates have been generated. Candidates will be able to download their respective hall tickets exclusively through the official CAT portal. To access the document, candidates will have to log in using their registered CAT application credentials. No separate mode of admit card distribution has been specified. The admit card is an essential examination document. Candidates should download it as soon as it becomes available and check the details mentioned on it carefully. Any discrepancy in the information should be brought to the attention of the examination authorities through the official communication channels. CAT 2026 admit card: Steps to download hall ticket
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the CAT admit card 2026 from the official website: Visit the official website, iimcat.ac.in.
 Click on the CAT 2026 candidate login link.
 Enter the CAT application login ID and password.
 Submit the login credentials to access the candidate dashboard.
 Locate the CAT 2026 admit card download link.
 Open the admit card and verify the details mentioned in the document.
 Download and save the hall ticket.
 Take a printout for use on the examination day.
 Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the CAT 2026 admit card notice. Candidates are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the CAT hall ticket 2026.
